subject: Close playbook: sequencing MSA, DPA and order form for Acme Robotics
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Close playbook: sequencing MSA, DPA and order form for Acme Robotics

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) proposal in writing to align procurement + legal sequencing so we can meet your goal of onboarded inference capacity by mid-July. Attached are: a redlined MSA draft that reflects the commercial terms we've discussed, our draft order form, and a short DPA checklist.

High level proposal:
- Week 1 (this week): Acme procurement confirms internal PO/finance gating items and shares any mandatory clauses.
- Week 2: Legal redlines MSA/DPA; we exchange and aim to converge on commercial/legal comments.
- Week 3: Finalize order form and execute MSA + order form (DocuSign) — production access gated on DPA being effective or executed as a separate signature concurrently.
- Week 4: Post-signing operational kickoff and security evidence handoff (SOC2 reports, encryption keys decisions).

Questions for you: what internal lead will own the PO timing? Are there any procurement playbooks or required attachments (certs, vendor questionnaire) we should surface now? Also flag any timing constraints from your finance team that would require us to compress the MSA/DPA window.

Attachments: redlined_MSA_jonas_v1.docx, order-form-draft.pdf, DPA-checklist_acme.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-minute sync if helpful.

— Jonas
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers:
- PO owner: Lisa Gomez (me) — finance needs the final order form and an approved vendor W9 by signature.
- Timing: legal at Acme will need ~7 business days for an initial review; procurement wants a final commercial signoff before submitting PO. If your MSA redline includes our standard data processing language, that will speed DPA review.

We reviewed the attachments at a high level. Two immediate asks from procurement/legal:
1) Can you provide a short exhibit that lists what data types Redwood will process during evaluation (sample logs, telemetry, training/test inputs)? This helps our DPA scoping.
2) We will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a basic network diagram before production access.

Attached is our drafting of a procurement_timeline.xlsx that shows internal dates. Based on that, our expected dates: legal redline complete by 2026-06-18, procurement PO issued by 2026-06-22, signatures completed by 2026-06-24. If you can compress any of the legal review items that would help.

Lisa Gomez

Looping in a suggested evaluation plan so procurement understands gating vs. operational needs. Adding to Jonas' MAP:

Evaluation plan (2-week sandbox):
- Week A (Day 0–7): Provisioning of a dedicated sandbox cluster (non-production), seeded sample dataset (synthetic) and access for Acme devs. Security evidence delivered at Day 2 (SOC2 link + network diagram).
- Week B (Day 8–14): Run the defined test cases from the evaluation kit, provide a short quality report. If results meet acceptance criteria, we proceed to order form and MSA signature for production.

Key sequencing ask from GTM: we prefer to execute MSA + Order Form concurrently (DocuSign envelope) to avoid rework in billing/entitlement. DPA can be signed parallelly but must be effective before we unlock production keys or connect customer data. If Acme insists on DPA in hand before signature, we need to know so we can prepare a prioritized redline.

Also: attached a copy of our order-form-draft.pdf with example SKUs and billing cadence — please flag any mandatory finance fields you require.

— Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@acme.com>, Evan Park <e.park@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close playbook: sequencing MSA, DPA and order form for Acme Robotics

(Internal counsel and suggested sequencing)

Folks — I reviewed Jonas' redline and Acme's asks. My recommendation to eliminate friction:
1) Execute MSA and Order Form together in DocuSign. The Order Form captures commercial terms and purchase commitment; signing both together avoids duplicate signature cycles.
2) DPA: provide as a separate signature that can be executed in parallel. However, make the Order Form contingent on the DPA being "effective" prior to production use (we can include a clause in the Order Form: "DPA Effective Date shall be a precondition to access to production keys").
3) For accelerated timelines, offer a limited "evaluation data" addendum that allows access to synthetic/test datasets before the DPA is fully finalized (strictly scoped, time-boxed, and auditable). This preserves the evaluation while protecting both parties.

Top legal issues to spot-check in negotiation: data subject rights delegation, subprocessors list, encryption-at-rest key ownership, liability cap alignment, audit right scope. I've attached our legal redline (redline_MSA_from_legal.docx) and a short DPA-checklist that maps each DPA clause to go/no-go for production.

If Acme legal wants to exchange markups directly, request their redline as a tracked Word doc to accelerate instatement.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_MSA_from_legal.docx, DPA-checklist_acme.xlsx

Thanks all — proposing the following agreed MAP and next steps to lock the timeline Lisa shared:

Agreed MAP and milestones:
- 2026-06-15: Redwood to send final MSA redline (Grace's version attached) and a proposed DocuSign envelope for MSA + Order Form.
- 2026-06-18: Acme legal to return redlines or confirm approval (per Lisa's timeline).
- 2026-06-22: Acme issuance of PO and signature completion targeted by 2026-06-24.
- Pre-production gating: DPA must be effective before production data flows; Redwood to enable sandbox access immediately after Order Form signature.

Immediate asks from Redwood:
1) Lisa — confirm the PO owner contact and any mandatory invoice fields we should include on the order form (vendor W9 already requested).
2) Evan — if Acme legal will share a redline, please send as tracked Word so Grace can do a line-by-line compare.

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the limited evaluation addendum Grace suggested to avoid blocking the evaluation. If everyone agrees, I'll schedule a 20-minute sync tomorrow to confirm DocuSign recipients and the PO format.

Thanks —
Jonas
